_doc: Base config for the Caddy instance internal/deploy.CaddyClient talks
to (PRD §9.7, FR-062). JSON, not a Caddyfile: Caddy names Caddyfile-derived
server blocks automatically (srv0, srv1, ...) with no stable way to pin
a name from Caddyfile syntax alone, and CaddyClient.RegisterRoute needs
to address the 'previews' server by that exact name on every call.
AUTOMATIC HTTPS FOR THE PREVIEW WILDCARD IS NOT CONFIGURED HERE.
A wildcard host (*.<ANVIL_PREVIEW_DOMAIN>) can only get a certificate
via ACME's DNS-01 challenge, which requires a DNS provider plugin
built into the Caddy binary (e.g. github.com/caddy-dns/cloudflare) and
API credentials for that provider — both are real infrastructure
choices (which DNS host, which API token) this file cannot make for
you. Without it, Caddy falls back to its internal CA for the preview
server, which issues real certificates but ones browsers won't trust
automatically — fine for local development, not for a public preview
